How I work

Analysis that supports the decision, not just the report.

I'm Rawan Ahmed, a Data Analyst who works where data meets business and growth. I look at user behavior, campaigns, transactions and operations to find what is working, what is not, and what to do next.

My work combines business understanding, SQL and Excel analysis, KPI development and clear communication. Dashboards and automation are tools I use to make the findings easy for stakeholders to act on.
